A1.justification: Both complete 52-page PDFs describe the same ALEXR research work. Text and visual comparison cover the main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–H; the appendix pages are identical.

before.justification: v2 reports original GDRO and restricted-TPR partial-AUC experiments in Section 9, including test scores in Tables 4–5 and additional empirical analysis in Appendix F.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Section 9 and Appendix F, including classification accuracy, partial-AUC scores, and convergence curves.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, Equation (5.1), sampling, extrapolation, and mirror-map choices are unchanged. Section 7 adds descriptions of existing dual updates; the PDFs do not establish a change to the underlying algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GDRO on Adult and CelebA and restricted-TPR partial-AUC maximization on Covtype, Cardiomegaly, Lung-mass, and Higgs. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 4 retains SGD, SGD-UW, OOA, BSGD, SOX, and SONX as comparators. Table 5 retains CE, OOA, BSGD, SOX, SONX, and SOTA. Comparator participation in the corresponding experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 9 and Appendix F retain the same splits, preprocessing, linear models, thresholds, minibatches, tuning ranges, and iteration budgets. The added Section 7 formulas do not document revised experimental settings.

E4.justification: Appendix F.1.3 retains Figure 3's group-population analysis and comparison of estimated Ω₀Y with its worst-case bound. Appendix H retains the theoretical ablation with θ = 0. No analyses are added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendices F.1.2 and F.2.2 specify five runs with different random seeds in both versions. Tables 4–5 retain the same ± reporting, with no changes to statistical estimation practices.

E6.justification: Tables 4–5 and Figures 1–3 retain their scores, curves, and findings. For example, ALEXR's Adult accuracy at α = 0.1 remains 56.58 ± 0.69%, and its Higgs partial AUC at TPR ≥ 0.5 remains 0.485 ± 0.000.

T1.justification: Section 7.2 adds an explicit Euclidean χ² dual-update formula whose τ scaling is inconsistent with Algorithm 1 and the stated conjugate. The other added updates restate existing mathematics, including Equation (5.1) and Lemma 11. Assumptions, convergence bounds, and appendix proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about single-loop optimization, improved convergence rates, optimality within the specified algorithm class, and applicability to GDRO and partial-AUC maximization.

C2.justification: The sparsity-based interpretation in Remark 8, baseline-complexity discussion in Section 7.3, empirical interpretations in Section 9, and qualifications concerning mirror-map smoothness remain unchanged. No substantive limitations are added or removed.

D1.justification: Sections 7.1–7.2 now spell out dual-update expressions for CVaR and χ² applications where v2 described efficiently solvable proximal mappings. This expands implementation documentation, although one expression is inconsistent. Appendix F's preprocessing, hyperparameters, hardware, and code-access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: All 71 reference entries and substantive research-positioning discussions are retained. Section 3.4 removes a duplicated citation to reference 55 without removing the cited work or changing its treatment.

P1.justification: The revision locally expands the explanations in Sections 7.1–7.2, removes a duplicate citation, and updates the arXiv version/date header. The section sequence and overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 20 to page 21, Table 4 shifts below it, and Table 5 moves from page 21 to page 23 without content changes. Added formulas reflow subsequent text and references; a stray marker in Table 1 is removed.

improvement.justification: v2 leaves the χ² Euclidean update implicit; v3 adds λ/(1+λ) times (y_old + g_tilde/τ + 1) in Section 7.2. Algorithm 1 with the stated conjugate instead gives λ(τ*y_old + g_tilde + 1)/(1+λ*τ) for an interior solution. This new inconsistency can mislead implementation and outweighs the limited explanatory and typographic gains. The core algorithm, proofs, and empirical evidence remain intact, so the decline is localized.
